complicacoes.texto: John is prone to second-guess himself after his role in the Destruição of Xanshi.
The power ring needs periodic recharging and issues a warning as its power runs low.

Green Lantern power rings depend on the willpower of the wearer; the maximum graduação of the ring’s effects is equal to the wearer’s Vontade graduação, and moments of self-doubt or hesitation can cause the ring to fail.
